focus_note: Blue Dart labels in this set are largely non-tagged PDFs, so structure-hash and MCID checks are secondary. Focus more on content operators, XObjects, image usage, object graph size, and path-op drift.
baseline_note: Use at least two or more genuine Blue Dart PDFs covering each generator family. If only one real sample is present, candidates from another genuine family may score as suspicious.
supportive_signals_note: Rule-based gate check. BLUE DART PASSED only when every selected Blue Dart hard gate matches a real sample. Any failed gate makes the candidate BLUE DART SUSPICIOUS.
